title: Born in Houston in 1918; a musical family
summary: Cobb gives his birth date, August 10, 1918, and says his grandmother taught piano and his mother, an uncle and an aunt played.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in Houston, Texas in the year of 1918, August 10. And that gives a little indication of my age, when you said 1978. It makes me 59 now, until August 10th.
Yeah, that's right. So then you have to take a couple off for a year or two.
Well, I'll get up to 60 and be very proud and I'm going to tell you why later, and the older I get the prouder I get. I'll tell you why I'm glad.
Oh. So your mother played, too.
She played, too. My uncle played. Had a couple or three of the ten kids that played, the ones that were interested; I'll put it like that.

You only get out of life what you put into it and if you apply yourself, you're going to get it, but if you're not going to apply yourself, you're not going to get it. So the ones that applied themselves got it.
So my mother was one; my uncle was one; and another aunt was one; and that was it. I don't how I came through.
